reason: the sre lens's findings the code or a test must fix

findings.text: sre lens, high: The cycle:* skip-on-resume guard reads `.stage_statuses["$_cyc_id"]` for `"complete"`, but `_update_stage_status` is never called with a cycle ID — that key is never written, so the guard is permanently dead code; a fully-converged cycle always re-runs on resume, and in a pipeline with multiple sequential cycles the re-run consumes `_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE` before the actually-interrupted downstream cycle sees it, breaking ITER-1 for that cycle. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:3442; fix: code)

sre lens, medium: `_runner_resume_rehydrate` silently swallows an `_artifact_persist_restore` failure — it returns 0 with no log or warn line, so when the restore fails (missing state branch, git error, permission) the operator sees only the downstream 'artifact absent after rehydration' message at dispatch time with no indication the git restore itself failed; `_ARTIFACT_PERSIST_LAST_REASON` is set by the restore but never read or logged here. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1712; fix: code)

sre lens, medium: `_runner_from_stage_preflight` is declared to accept four parameters but silently depends on the global `$_runner_issue` for the restore call instead of using the passed `<state_dir>` parameter's owning issue; if `_runner_issue` ever holds its default value `"0"` (the initializer at line 163) the restore reads the wrong state branch and all rehydration silently succeeds against an empty or wrong branch, allowing `--from-stage` to report success for missing artifacts of unrelated issues. (core/pipeline/runner.sh:1734; fix: code)
